profit_quality.assessment: Medium. 2023 cash generation improved, but reported parent profit includes a HKD 23.135m income tax credit and other net income includes rental income, interest, FX and disposal gains. 2021-2023 net operating cash flow less PPE capex was HKD 24.408m, HKD 21.795m and HKD 64.203m; the main case uses HKD 35.0m pre-haircut distributable cash profit and a 0.70 cash-profit haircut.
adjustments: Did not use 2023 parent net profit HKD 85.898m directly because it includes a large deferred-tax driven income tax credit.
Excluded reliance on one best cash-flow year; used recent three-year FCF and parent profit range to set a conservative pre-haircut denominator.
Kept ordinary operating lease burden mostly in profit/cash-flow quality rather than treating all continuing operating leases as detachable cash deductions.
No separate deduction for investment property value in the main formula; investment properties are operating/asset optionality, not cash.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Net operating cash flow: 2021 HKD 37.031m, 2022 HKD 37.159m, 2023 HKD 88.707m. PPE capex: 2021 HKD 12.623m, 2022 HKD 15.364m, 2023 HKD 24.504m.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Three-year cash generation is positive but uneven, 2023 profit quality is helped by tax credit and non-core income, and Mainland cash/control extraction is not fully transparent.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: 2023 operating cash flow exceeded adjusted profit, but 2021-2022 FCF was only around HKD 22-24m.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Main case uses 2023 PPE purchase HKD 24.504m as a conservative capex reference; three-year PPE capex range HKD 12.623m-24.504m.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2023 working capital released cash overall, mainly inventories down and related-party receivables down; this release is not assumed recurring.

limitations: Market cap is from rough-screen historical signal, not independently re-priced.
Annual report discloses Mainland China cash but not a full parent/subsidiary cash split for all cash.
Necessary operating cash is estimated from revenue and working-capital needs because the report does not disclose management's minimum cash requirement.
